items.text: Kelp Cove, before dawn: this deployment uses eastern and western moorings. The western logger is hanging two metres above the anchor. We are recording continuously through the ferry interval; no test sounds will be transmitted.
items.reason: Clarifies that both moorings belong to the same Kelp Cove deployment, grounding the later eastern-anchor reminder.

items.text: Reference tank: repeat the gain sweep after the bubbles settle. The reference-tank program recalibrates recorders for several independent field projects on a continuing bench schedule.
items.reason: Establishes the continuing calibration program's scope across field projects so its transfer of results to Kelp Cove has source-supported project boundaries.

items.text: Kelp Cove deployment reminder: recover the eastern anchor after sunrise tomorrow.
items.reason: Names the deployment explicitly while retaining the original recovery instruction.

items.text: Workshop helper: the teaching bench needs six spare point motors. The club's beginner turnout-wiring course runs over six weeks; its exhibition taster is an outreach session before the next cohort starts back at the club.
items.reason: Establishes a continuing multiweek club course whose exhibition taster is one outreach session, supporting its identity beyond the exhibition.

items.text: Lender desk handover: the green brake van arrived with one missing buffer. Photograph that end before attaching the loan number, and copy the condition note onto the return sheet. The desk handles the club's year-round inter-layout rolling-stock loans; condition and return records follow each vehicle through bookings beyond the exhibition.
items.reason: Establishes the lender desk as a continuing club loan service with records and bookings extending beyond the exhibition.

items.text: Floor steward and workshop tutor: move the waiting line for the club turnout-wiring course's exhibition taster to the wall marked on the exhibition access plan. The teaching bench can keep six seats only if its audience leaves the cross-aisle open.
items.reason: Identifies the course's exhibition taster as the activity sharing the exhibition access plan, retaining the explicit coordination between them.
